comment: Xotic BB Preamp: 2SC1815 input buffer, 4558 soft-clipping stage with 1N914s, a second 4558 gain stage, an active Bass/Treble stack and a 2SC1815 output buffer; the Volume is a dual-gang pot drawn as Volume A and Volume B.
rows: four op-amp sections drawn = two dual chips
dual-gang: section A (pins 1-3) sets output level, section B (pins 4-6, wired as variable resistor) sets gain of the boost stage
